cases.text: the person wearing a black bucket hat, a dark jacket with yellow accents, and dark pants with white sneakers

cases.text: the person with a red feathered headpiece and a dark patterned jacket

cases.text: the person wearing a black t-shirt, black shorts with white checkered cuffs, and a black cap with a yellow brim

cases.text: the person with long dark hair, glasses, a black cropped top, black blazer, and black flared pants

cases.text: the person with long black hair wearing a black blazer, black pants, and a white bow tie with black heels
cases.prior_observation: P03为长黑发、黑西装裤与外套、黑高跟鞋；颈部可见白领/白衬衫配深色细带，无法确认white bow tie。模型把白色领部与领结混称；该属性不够准确，需用户核查后采用。
